{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Real Professional Grade Gaffer Tape| USA Made | No Residue | Non-Reflective | Multipurpose| Durable & Versatile | Bright & Vibrant |Weather Resistant | Heavy-Duty | Green Fluorescent, 2 in X 30 Yds; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have used utility tape, but I do not currently need fluorescent marking tape.
ItemID: 2; Title: Etekcity Infrared Thermometer 1080, Heat Temperature Temp Gun for Cooking, Laser IR Surface Tool for Pizza Oven, Meat, Griddle, Grill, HVAC, Engine, Accessories, -58°F to 1130°F, Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A useful inspection tool, but my history does not suggest a current need for surface temperature measurements.
ItemID: 3; Title: NEIKO 50432A Hex Nut Assortment Set | 150 Pc Nylon Locking Nuts | A3 Steel Hex Assorted Hardware Kit #10 & SAE | Metal Screw Nut for Bolts | Friction Lock Nut; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy practical repair supplies, but would wait until I need these particular nut sizes.
ItemID: 4; Title: Gorilla 2 Part Epoxy, 5 Minute Set, .85 Ounce Syringe, Clear, (Pack of 1); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The small quantity and quick setting time appeal for occasional repairs, consistent with my tape and adhesive purchases.
ItemID: 5; Title: Ginsco 580 pcs 2:1 Heat Shrink Tubing Kit 6 Colors 11 Sizes Assorted Sleeving Tube Wrap Cable Wire Kit for DIY; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Assorted tubing would complement my electrical crimp connectors by insulating and protecting wire connections.
ItemID: 6; Title: Dykem 80300 Steel Blue Layout Fluid, Brush-in-Cap (4oz); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This is specialized metalworking material, and I have no clear use for precision layout work.
ItemID: 7; Title: URBEST 530 Pcs 2:1 Heat Shrink Tubing Tube Sleeving Wrap Cable Wire 5 Color 8 Size (530Pcs Heat Shrink Tube); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my electrical repair interests, but I would choose the other tubing assortment this time and avoid buying two.
ItemID: 8; Title: J-B Weld 8271 KwikWeld Professional Size Steel Reinforced Epoxy Twin Pack - 10 oz.; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The large pack and steel repair focus exceed the occasional adhesive needs suggested by my purchases.
ItemID: 9; Title: VELCRO Brand - Industrial Strength | Indoor & Outdoor Use | Superior Holding Power on Smooth Surfaces | Size 4ft x 2in | Tape, White - Pack of 1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Removable fastening would be a useful addition to the tapes and clamps I have bought for practical fixing tasks.
ItemID: 10; Title: Plastic Transfer Pipettes 3ml, Graduated, Pack of 100; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My portion cup purchase alone does not give me a reason to buy a bulk pack of small liquid transfer tools."}
